subject: FATAL ERROR in inputs: 53 tree tips are not in the geographic ranges file.

messages.author: 1ce05dd715687bb9
messages.subject: FATAL ERROR in inputs: 53 tree tips are not in the geographic ranges file.
parts:
Hi,


I have fed my newick tree and geog files into BioGeoBEARS (see below) and it appears to be able to read the raw data, but when I try to check the inputs using check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object) I get the following error. It says that none of the 53 tips in my tree are in the geog file. Can anyone suggest what I may have done wrong? Thanks in advance.


Error in check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object) : 

FATAL ERROR in inputs: 53 tree tips are not in the geographic ranges file.  These are… (all of them)


Regards,

James

messages.author: 1f047fa58de5c694
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] FATAL ERROR in inputs: 53 tree tips are not in the geographic ranges file.
parts:
I wanted to add to this thread for future users. I came up with the same fatal error while trying to check inputs using

check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

I discovered that the error was caused by an extra white space that was included in the species names in the species range file (geogfn). That file was created in excel, saved as a tab delimited text file and then modified the file using RegEx in Notepad++. However, I did not realize that each name was followed by a space, followed by a tab, followed by the range data. After removing the space (keeping only the single tab) everything ran smoothly.

On Monday, December 14, 2015 at 1:48:52 AM UTC-5, James Shelley wrote:
That did the trick- thanks Nick.

Regards,
James
